offers_products.reason: Sells cryogenic and ultra-cold storage systems, freezers, automation instruments, consumables and Limfinity software to labs.

offers_services.reason: Sample storage biorepository services, cold chain logistics, and GENEWIZ genomics sequencing and synthesis services; services are the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are pharma, biotech, research labs and fertility clinics; individuals are not main buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Pharmaceutical companies, CDMOs, academic and research institutions, and clinics buy storage services, instruments and genomics services.

recurring_revenue.reason: Long-term sample storage fees, repeat genomics orders and consumables recur, though instrument sales and projects are one-off.

cyclical_demand.reason: Research and drug storage needs persist; biobank storage is sticky, though biotech funding swings affect some instrument and genomics demand.

big_ticket.reason: Most revenue is recurring storage fees and genomics sequencing orders, which are small and frequent, despite some capital instrument sales.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from biorepository facilities, freezers, automation, software and lab equipment rather than mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large pharmaceutical companies, CDMOs, biotechs and major research institutions, though academic labs are also served.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates many cGMP biorepository facilities worldwide with cryogenic storage, automated stores and mobile biorepositories, needing ongoing facility investment.

notes: Mix of sample management services and genomics services plus products; the split between products and services is uncertain.
